inference_scope: Descriptive paired source-by-seed bootstrap; only 16 timing sources and 5 seeds; no guaranteed coverage or main-test replacement

profile.additional_costs: archive append per request; final archive close and fsync; closed-archive readback and scoring per row; setup and total process phases

bootstrap.unit: paired crossed source and training_seed, retaining all views/scenarios

profile.failure_rule: retain every attempted row and actual cost; no dropped outliers; unavailable quality blocks that condition/observer's quality inference
profile.main_request_timer: owner RNG setup, public sensor if used, encoder, actual chosen transitions, policy decisions, lossless terminal NPZ memory serialization and payload SHA256
profile.observation_stream: abc-next-timing-observation,test,0,16; shared across views, arms, seeds and scenarios
profile.policy_order: cyclic rotation by global seed/arm/view/case/scenario group ordinal
profile.quality_scope: descriptive timing cohort only, not a replacement for main 512-source test
profile.raw_media: local ZIP_STORED container of per-request lossless NPZ bytes; no raw data in Git

training_scope: Controller collection process cost retained separately; original generator training and sensor training remain separate registered receipts, not included in request latency
